title: Who Pays More for Safety? Measuring the Disparate Cost of Safety Alignment across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'Safety Cost' (utility degradation) by conducting pairwise comparisons of responses between safety-aligned models and their safety-ablated (unaligned) counterparts on benign, over-refusal prompts across multiple languages (English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Arabic, Korean, and Thai) using an LLM-as-a-judge.
